title: 「On the one hand …; on the other hand …」句
titleZh: 「On the one hand …; on the other hand …」表達事物的兩面
titleEn: On the one hand …; on the other hand …

source.file: Sentence Structure 251 - 「On the one hand …; on the other hand …」表達事物的兩面.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than this system lesson ID because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: On the one hand, + complete clause; on the other hand, + complete clause

formulas.formula: On the one hand, clause 1; on the other hand, clause 2.
For + group, + overview clause: on the one hand, clause 1; on the other hand, clause 2.
Subject + has mixed effects / has two sides. On the one hand, clause 1; on the other hand, clause 2.
Subject + involves a trade-off: on the one hand, clause 1; on the other hand, clause 2.
When + situation, + overview clause: on the one hand, clause 1; on the other hand, clause 2.
V-ing + topic + involves / creates / brings + a trade-off: on the one hand, clause 1; on the other hand, clause 2.

example: On the one hand, remote work saves time; on the other hand, it can feel isolating.
exampleZh: 遙距工作一方面可以節省時間；另一方面，也可能令人感到孤立。

meaning.zh: 用兩個固定連接語清楚呈現同一主題的兩個不同方面，通常是好處與限制、優點與缺點或兩種取捨。

rules.zh: 核心表達只有 on the one hand 和 on the other hand 兩個部分；主題框架只是可選的引入語。
rules.en: The core expression contains only on the one hand and on the other hand. A topic frame is an optional introduction.

rules.zh: 兩部分應表達同一主題真正不同的方面，而不是完全無關的資料。
rules.en: The two parts must present genuinely different aspects of the same subject rather than unrelated information.

rules.zh: 不一定要先寫好處；先寫哪一面取決於你希望怎樣組織答案。
rules.en: The positive side does not have to come first. Choose the order that best organises the answer.

rules.zh: the 是固定表達的一部分，必須寫成 on the one hand 和 on the other hand。
rules.en: The word the is fixed and must appear in both on the one hand and on the other hand.

rules.zh: 每個連接語後通常使用逗號。
rules.en: Place a comma after each connector.

rules.zh: 兩個完整子句可用分號連接，也可分成兩句；本練習的標準答案使用分號。
rules.en: Two complete clauses may be joined with a semicolon or written as separate sentences. The standard answers in this exercise use a semicolon.

rules.zh: 兩部分的文法形式應盡量平衡，令對比更清楚。
rules.en: Keep the grammar of the two parts as balanced as possible so that the contrast is clear.

rules.zh: 代名詞必須有清楚所指，避免 it、they 或 this 造成含糊。
rules.en: Make every pronoun reference clear so that it, they or this cannot be misunderstood.

benefits.zh: 能立即清楚顯示同一主題的兩個方面。
benefits.en: It makes the two sides immediately clear.

benefits.zh: 能同時承認好處和限制，使立場更平衡。
benefits.en: It helps you present a balanced opinion.

benefits.zh: 兩個固定語像清晰路標，有助組織較長答案。
benefits.en: It organises longer answers by marking where each side begins.

benefits.zh: 可替代重複使用 but，增加連接方式的變化。
benefits.en: It gives you an alternative to repeatedly using but.

benefits.zh: 適合呈現真正的取捨：一個選擇解決某問題，同時可能帶來另一問題。
benefits.en: It can highlight a genuine trade-off.

benefits.zh: 可放在句首、主題框架或概括語後，令句子開首更多變。
benefits.en: It allows more varied sentence openings.

questions.answer: Allowing students to use phones at school involves both opportunity and risk: on the one hand, the devices can support learning; on the other hand, they can cause distraction.
questions.answerZh: 允許學生在校內使用電話同時帶來機會和風險：一方面，這些裝置可以支援學習；另一方面，也可能令學生分心。
questions.highlight: Allowing students to use phones at school involves both opportunity and risk: on the one hand, the devices can support learning; on the other hand, they can cause distraction.

questions.prompt: Longer daily working hours may be tiring under a four-day working week, but the arrangement may improve work-life balance.
questions.promptZh: 在四天工作周下，每日較長的工時可能令人疲倦，但這種安排也可能改善工作與生活的平衡。
questions.answer: On the one hand, a four-day working week may require longer and more tiring working days; on the other hand, it may improve work-life balance.
questions.answerZh: 四天工作周一方面可能導致每日工時更長、更令人疲倦；另一方面，也可能改善工作與生活的平衡。
questions.highlight: On the one hand, a four-day working week may require longer and more tiring working days; on the other hand, it may improve work-life balance.

questions.prompt: For small businesses, selling online can reach more customers, but delivery and return costs can be difficult to control.
questions.promptZh: 對小型企業而言，網上銷售可以接觸更多顧客，但送貨及退貨成本可能難以控制。
questions.answer: For small businesses, selling online offers opportunities and challenges: on the one hand, it can reach more customers; on the other hand, delivery and return costs can be difficult to control.

questions.highlight: For small businesses, selling online offers opportunities and challenges: on the one hand, it can reach more customers; on the other hand, delivery and return costs can be difficult to control.

questions.prompt: The city needs more homes, but residents also want to protect open space.
questions.promptZh: 城市需要更多住宅，但居民也希望保護休憩用地。
questions.answer: The decision to build more flats creates a difficult balance. On the one hand, the city needs more homes; on the other hand, residents want to protect open space.
questions.answerZh: 增建住宅的決定需要在兩方面取得平衡。一方面，城市需要更多住宅；另一方面，居民希望保護休憩用地。
questions.highlight: The decision to build more flats creates a difficult balance. On the one hand, the city needs more homes; on the other hand, residents want to protect open space.

questions.prompt: A permanent job offers greater security, whereas freelance work may provide more freedom.
questions.promptZh: 長期職位提供較大保障，而自由工作可能帶來更多自主空間。
questions.answer: When choosing between a permanent job and freelance work, people must weigh two different priorities: on the one hand, a permanent job offers greater security; on the other hand, freelance work may provide more freedom.
questions.answerZh: 在長期職位和自由工作之間作選擇時，人們需要衡量兩項不同考慮：一方面，長期職位提供較大保障；另一方面，自由工作可能帶來更多自主空間。
questions.highlight: When choosing between a permanent job and freelance work, people must weigh two different priorities: on the one hand, a permanent job offers greater security; on the other hand, freelance work may provide more freedom.

questions.prompt: When several generations live together, family members can support one another, but they may have less privacy.
questions.promptZh: 幾代家庭成員同住時，可以互相支持，但各人的私人空間可能會減少。
questions.answer: Living with several generations under one roof brings both support and pressure: on the one hand, family members can support one another; on the other hand, they may have less privacy.
questions.answerZh: 幾代家庭成員同住既帶來支持，也帶來壓力：一方面，家庭成員可以互相支持；另一方面，各人的私人空間可能會減少。
questions.highlight: Living with several generations under one roof brings both support and pressure: on the one hand, family members can support one another; on the other hand, they may have less privacy.

questions.prompt: Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes while being driven, but making their batteries requires large amounts of raw materials.

questions.prompt: From the government’s point of view, raising public transport fares could place more pressure on low-income passengers, but it could increase revenue.
questions.promptZh: 從政府的角度來看，提高公共交通票價可能加重低收入乘客的負擔，但可以增加收入。
questions.answer: From the government’s point of view, raising public transport fares presents a difficult trade-off: on the one hand, it could place greater pressure on low-income passengers; on the other hand, it could increase revenue.

questions.prompt: Recording every lesson might make teachers and students less comfortable speaking openly. However, absent students could review the material.
questions.promptZh: 錄影每一堂課可能令師生較不願意公開發言。然而，缺席學生可以重溫教材。
questions.answer: The proposal to record all lessons raises two important concerns. On the one hand, teachers and students might feel less comfortable speaking openly; on the other hand, absent students could review the material.
questions.answerZh: 錄影所有課堂的建議涉及兩項重要考慮。一方面，師生可能較不願意公開發言；另一方面，缺席學生可以重溫教材。
questions.highlight: The proposal to record all lessons raises two important concerns. On the one hand, teachers and students might feel less comfortable speaking openly; on the other hand, absent students could review the material.

questions.prompt: International visitors support local businesses, but popular destinations can become overcrowded.
questions.promptZh: 國際旅客能支持本地企業，但熱門旅遊地點可能變得過度擠迫。
questions.answer: In international tourism, communities can experience both benefits and pressure: on the one hand, visitors support local businesses; on the other hand, popular destinations can become overcrowded.

questions.highlight: In international tourism, communities can experience both benefits and pressure: on the one hand, visitors support local businesses; on the other hand, popular destinations can become overcrowded.

questions.prompt: Self-service machines may reduce the personal support available to customers, although they can provide faster service.
questions.promptZh: 自助服務機可能減少顧客獲得的個人協助，但可以提供更快捷的服務。
questions.answer: Introducing self-service machines offers efficiency but also creates a risk: on the one hand, customers may receive less personal support; on the other hand, they may be served more quickly.
questions.answerZh: 引入自助服務機可以提升效率，但也帶來風險：一方面，顧客可能獲得較少個人協助；另一方面，他們可能更快獲得服務。
questions.highlight: Introducing self-service machines offers efficiency but also creates a risk: on the one hand, customers may receive less personal support; on the other hand, they may be served more quickly.

questions.highlight: For universities, admitting more international students brings both gains and pressures: on the one hand, housing and support services may come under pressure; on the other hand, cultural exchange may increase.

questions.prompt: The old market needs safer and more modern facilities, but local residents want to preserve its history.
questions.promptZh: 舊市場需要更安全和現代化的設施，但本區居民希望保留它的歷史。
questions.answer: The plan to redevelop the old market creates a difficult balance. On the one hand, the area needs safer and more modern facilities; on the other hand, local residents want to preserve its history.
questions.answerZh: 重建舊市場的計劃需要在兩方面取得平衡。一方面，該區需要更安全和現代化的設施；另一方面，本區居民希望保留它的歷史。
questions.highlight: The plan to redevelop the old market creates a difficult balance. On the one hand, the area needs safer and more modern facilities; on the other hand, local residents want to preserve its history.

questions.prompt: Stricter environmental rules may increase operating costs for some businesses, but they may also reduce pollution.
questions.promptZh: 更嚴格的環保規例可能增加部分企業的營運成本，但也可能減少污染。
questions.answer: When governments introduce stricter environmental rules, they must weigh two effects: on the one hand, some businesses may face higher operating costs; on the other hand, pollution may fall.
questions.answerZh: 政府引入更嚴格的環保規例時，需要衡量兩方面的影響：一方面，部分企業可能面對更高營運成本；另一方面，污染可能減少。
questions.highlight: When governments introduce stricter environmental rules, they must weigh two effects: on the one hand, some businesses may face higher operating costs; on the other hand, pollution may fall.

questions.highlight: Expanding airport capacity involves a serious trade-off: on the one hand, it can support tourism and business; on the other hand, it may increase noise and carbon emissions.

questions.highlight: From a public-health perspective, taxing sugary drinks has both benefits and costs: on the one hand, the policy may affect lower-income households more heavily; on the other hand, it may reduce consumption.

questions.prompt: Removing university tuition fees could widen access, but governments would need to find a large amount of public funding.

questions.highlight: In the debate over free university education, governments face two competing priorities: on the one hand, they would need to find a large amount of public funding; on the other hand, removing tuition fees could widen access.

questions.highlight: Adopting a fully automated transport system involves a serious trade-off: on the one hand, automation could improve efficiency and reduce human error; on the other hand, technical failures could affect many passengers at once.
